short-created.title: Short created
short-created.description: One rendered vertical 9:16 MP4 with burned-in captions, thumbnail and SRT (primary event). Failed clips are free.

clip-minute.title: Short video minute
clip-minute.description: Per started minute of output short video (1080x1920 or 720x1280), including transcription and caption rendering. Up to 0.5 s of padding is ignored when rounding.
